references.text: The angel of the Lord announces to Sarah that she will bear a son despite being barren and old, a similar pattern of divine announcement concerning a miraculous birth.
The angel of the Lord appears to Hagar and tells her that she will bear a son, the same pattern of an angelic announcement about a birth.
Rebekah was barren, but the Lord heard Isaac's prayer and she became pregnant. The theme of barrenness overcome by God.
The Lord opened Leah's womb when he saw that she was unloved. God's intervention in barrenness.
God remembered Rachel and opened her womb so that she gave birth to Joseph. A barren woman who gives birth through God's intervention.
Hannah was barren and prayed to the Lord for a son. God heard her prayer and she gave birth to Samuel. A similar pattern of a barren woman giving birth to an important leader.
The angel of the Lord appears to Zechariah and tells him that his barren wife Elizabeth will bear a son (John). A direct parallel to an angelic announcement about a miraculous birth.
The angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will become pregnant and give birth to a son. An angelic announcement concerning the birth of a special son.
The prophecy that a virgin will conceive and give birth to a son. Thematic connection to divine announcement concerning a special birth.
